newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab stones hamper Israeli general's Hebron tour.
newsitem.headline: Arab stones hamper Israeli general's Hebron tour.

text.p: Palestinians stoned the entourage of Israel's deputy army chief when he toured friction lines in Hebron on Monday, forcing him to change his route, witnesses said.
They said Major-General Matan Vilnai visited clash sites along an invisible line which under a peace deal divides the volatile West Bank city into areas of Israeli and Palestinian control.

The witnesses said one stone broke into pieces close to Vilnai's entourage, forcing him to return to the Israeli-held enclave. They said no one was hurt. An Israeli army spokesman was checking the report.

Hebron, a traditional flashpoint of Israeli-Palestinian violence, has witnessed near-daily clashes between Palestinians and Israeli troops since Jewish settlers shot dead an Arab shopkeeper last week.
Israeli soldiers detained five Palestinians during a search of houses in the Hebron-area village of Hatta but Palestinian security sources said the reason for the raid was unknown.
